integrity: The proof was reconstructed from the forward-orbit definition. Total disconnectedness is proved by induction on coordinate projections of an arbitrary connected subset; absence of isolated points is proved by a tail perturbation using nondegenerate fibers. The primary source was inspected at Theorems 3.11 and 3.16 and Question 3.18, and related generalized-inverse-limit literature was compared at the level needed to distinguish the objects and hypotheses.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is qualitative and concerns fixed-base forward orbit sets. It does not classify mixed fiber types, quantify fractal geometry, or claim that indexed searches exhaust all independent solutions of the 2025 question.
title: Totally disconnected nondegenerate fibers force Cantor orbit sets
